adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/api/add.ts`, the redirect URI is changed from `WEBAPP_URL + `/api/integrations/${appConfig.slug}/callback`` to a hardcoded `WEBAPP_URL + `/api/integrations/zoho-bigin/callback``. This is unrelated to the credential-sync feature added elsewhere in the PR and introduces extra churn for reviewers. It also weakens `config.json` (via `appConfig.slug`) as the single source of truth for the integration slug/callback path, creating a maintainability/scope concern even if it likely resolves to the same string today.
